title: Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.22466v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Harness evolution automatically optimizes the prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration code around a fixed-weight model, offering a way to improve agentic systems without updating model weights. The agent harness is iteratively optimized to achieve higher performance on the search set. But how much of this gain reflects benchmark-specific overfitting or additional inference-time compute, and how much may generalize beyond the search set? In this work, we introduce Harness-Delta Attribution (HDA), an evaluation protocol that dissects an evolution gain into artifact-driven overfitting, gains explained by test-time scaling, and the remainder, which gives an upper bound on residual generalizable improvement. We apply HDA to 11 executor models and three harness-evolution frameworks across math, coding, creativity, and agentic tasks. translated_title: Harness-Delta 归因：剖析 Harness 演化带来的增益
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.22466v1 公告类型：新论文。Harness 演化能够自动优化围绕固定权重模型的提示词、技能、工具与编排代码，为在不更新模型权重的情况下改进智能体系统提供了一种途径。智能体 harness 会被迭代优化，以在搜索集上取得更高的性能。但这些增益中有多少反映了针对特定基准的过拟合或额外的推理时计算量，又有多少能够泛化到搜索集之外？在本工作中，我们提出了 Harness-Delta 归因（HDA），这是一种评估协议，可将演化增益分解为三部分：由产物驱动的过拟合、可由测试时扩展解释的增益，以及剩余部分——该剩余部分给出了残余可泛化改进的上界。我们将 HDA 应用于 11 个执行器模型和三个 harness 演化框架，涵盖数学、编程、创造力和智能体任务。在这 21 个在搜索集上取得统计显著增益的设置中，我们发现其中很大一部分……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 Harness-Delta 归因（HDA）评估协议，将 harness 演化带来的性能提升分解为基准过拟合、测试时扩展计算与可泛化改进三部分，从而量化这些提升中有多少能够真正泛化到搜索集之外。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Harness-Delta Attribution (HDA), an evaluation protocol that decomposes gains from harness evolution into artifact-driven overfitting, test-time scaling effects, and a residual upper bound on generalizable improvement, quantifying how much of the observed gains truly generalize beyond the search set.
